_comment: Single source of truth for skill packs. The pack-builder reads these; build-packs.py emits one zip per pack into dashboard/packs/. A pack lists explicit `slugs` and/or a `category` folder that expands to every skill in it. A slug not yet in the library is skipped (logged), never an error.

learningPaths.title: Prepare an agent workflow
learningPaths.audience: Business owners and team leads trying one useful AI task
learningPaths.goal: Leave with one scoped task brief and a clear way to check its first saved result.
prerequisites: Bring one small task and approved sample inputs.
Use the app and account you already have; confirm needed access separately.
learningPaths.boundary: Practice with public or fictional inputs. This path does not install tools, grant access, publish work or start a schedule.

exercise.prompt: Choose a small draft you can check. Write its allowed input, expected output, pass checks and stop rule. Try it only with inputs you may use; save and reopen the result.
exercise.deliverable: A task brief plus a checked saved draft, or an exact missing-capability note.
checks: The brief names the result, source, audience and allowed actions.
Each important claim can be checked against the supplied input.
The saved output reopens; failures and unknowns stay visible.
A next owner and handoff are named. No automatic installation or schedule is claimed.

learningPaths.title: Run the Content Factory
learningPaths.audience: Creators, editors and agency teams turning real source material into useful content
learningPaths.goal: Turn one permitted source into an audience-specific opening and a checked editorial handoff.
prerequisites: Bring one permitted transcript or short source, a title and a draft.
Know who may approve and publish it; this session stops at the draft.
learningPaths.boundary: Produce → Process → Post → Promote remains the maintained method. This practice covers the brief, draft opening and handoff—not a completed publishing or promotion run.

exercise.prompt: Use one allowed source to write a brief and two or three opening sentences. Have a partner trace each factual claim to that source and identify who the piece helps.
exercise.deliverable: A source-linked brief, draft opening, visual plan and editor handoff.
checks: The goal, source content and intended reader agree.
The opening says what the reader can do and why it matters.
Claims and the proposed visual have sources and use permission.
Draft, approved and published states remain separate.

learningPaths.title: Review ads before changing spend
learningPaths.audience: Ad operators and agency owners reviewing a small campaign
learningPaths.goal: Make one evidence-backed keep, stop, change or hold recommendation without changing an account.
prerequisites: Bring a permitted dated export or use a clearly fictional example.
Include the goal, result definition, currency and reporting window.
learningPaths.boundary: Read and recommend only. No campaign launch, account connection, budget change or spending authority is granted by this training.

exercise.prompt: Compare two test rows against the goal set before the test. Recalculate each cost per result. Mark missing inputs as unknown and write one bounded next recommendation.
exercise.deliverable: A reproducible comparison and a Metrics → Analysis → Action note.
checks: Costs and results use matching periods, definitions and units.
Zero or missing denominators do not become a zero cost.
Observed results and possible explanations are separate.
The recommendation names an owner and the approval needed before spend changes.

learningPaths.title: Run clear team operations
learningPaths.audience: Managers and operators handing work between people or agents
learningPaths.goal: Give a teammate a task they can understand, check and hand back without guesswork.
prerequisites: Bring one repeat task and a safe example of its output.
Choose an actual receiving role; confirm acceptance outside this practice.
learningPaths.boundary: Draft the assignment and status update. Sending, new commitments and changing responsibilities follow the team's existing authority.

exercise.prompt: Write an assignment with inputs, allowed actions, output, early review and pass checks. Ask a partner to find one ambiguity. Revise it, then draft a truthful status update.
exercise.deliverable: A revised assignment, review note and unsent status draft.
checks: A fresh reader can identify the starting input and useful output.
The check judges the result, not just whether steps were attempted.
The status distinguishes drafted, delivered and accepted.
The next owner is explicit; acknowledgment is not assumed.

learningPaths.title: Run a digital marketing agency
learningPaths.audience: Agency owners choosing the next improvement across marketing, delivery and money
learningPaths.goal: Map the agency's strongest supported constraint and choose one bounded improvement.
prerequisites: Bring permitted summaries for demand, delivery quality and money, or a fictional case.
Keep client identities, contracts and private financial records out of public sessions.
learningPaths.boundary: This is an agency decision workshop, not a complete paid agency course or advice to change pricing, staffing or contracts. Keep protected courses at their existing source.

exercise.prompt: Map one measure for Marketing, Operations and Finance. State its source and time window, or mark the gap. Choose the best-supported constraint and propose one small action.
exercise.deliverable: A three-function map with one sourced constraint, next owner and check.
checks: Marketing, Operations and Finance are all considered without inventing numbers.
Reported revenue, collected cash, costs and profit are not substituted.
The constraint is supported or explicitly a hypothesis.
The action has an owner, a limit and an observable result to review.
